messages:
Hana: dropping a new take on the rollout safety rail UI — trying to balance discoverability of restore controls with accidental-click protection. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/safe/rollout-safety-rail (page: safety-rail-v1) Hana: quick context: we want a compact timeline row that surfaces: version id, small health dot, traffic % (or dot if <4%), and a tertiary 'safety' affordance (compact three-dot menu). pressing the safety affordance reveals "Restore" and "Pause" and an inline "Quick-undo" toggle. Leo: nice. first thought: the word "Restore" still scares product folks. can we test alternative microcopy like "Return to version" or "Switch to"? we should run a quick usability microtest. Priya: +1 on softer copy. also for keyboard users the menu must be reachable (tab to row, then Enter opens menu). menu items should have aria-labels like "Return to version v4.1.0". Marcus: engineering flag: inline quick-undo is new server work (needs short-lived revert tokens). prefer we implement toast-based undo first (client-driven) and reserve persistent quick-undo for later. for now, the menu should open a modal for any change that impacts >=10% traffic. Hana: good pragmatic constraint. rule doc: if change <=10% & single-region -> inline confirm + toast undo; else -> modal. i'll add that to the interaction spec. A11yBot: contrast scan: the proposed green health dot at 10px doesn't meet AA when placed on pale gray background. recommend increase size to 12px + darker green (#007a3d) or add a 1px stroke. Priya: accessibility note: when a version row gets focus, announce via aria-live: "Version v4.1 focused. Traffic 3%. Status: canary." For menu open, add role=menu and aria-modal behavior. modal must trap focus and announce progress states (e.g., "Restoring... 25% complete"). Leo: UX suggestion: add a tiny 'confidence' icon for A/B rows that, when hovered, shows a tooltip with plain-language summary ("Likely uplift", "No significant change"). avoid p-values on the surface. Marcus: backend note: the confidence summary comes from experiments service and may lag. the UI should show a stale indicator if data >5m old. tooltip text should include timestamp. Hana: copy nits for the modal: header candidate: "Return to v4.1.0?" body: "This will route new traffic to v4.1.0. Ongoing requests will finish on their current version. You can undo within 30s via the toast." CTA: "Return" secondary: "Cancel". Thoughts? Priya: "Return" reads well. screen reader addition: add aria-label to CTA: "Return to version v4.1.0" and include an sr-only sentence in modal body: "This action affects traffic routing and cannot be undone after the undo window." Marcus: also show a small inline progress indicator in the row while the restore is progressing. spinner inside the restore button and disable duplicate actions. emit an event for timeline so other clients refresh. Leo: interaction thought: for dense histories we should provide a "zoom" control to bin versions by week/month. when zoomed out, the restore action becomes a secondary action inside the expanded bin. prevents accidental restores in compressed views. Priya: keyboard mappings: Tab focuses row, Enter toggles expand (chevron), M opens menu, R triggers restore shortcut (with confirmation guard Ctrl+R). document alt flows for screen reader users who rely on keyboard-only. A11yBot: automated note: ensure that shortcuts like Ctrl+R are not globally reserved (browser). prefer Shift+R or provide a preferences toggle in settings. Marcus: good call. we'll pick Shift+R as default and make it configurable. also note: with virtualization we must keep the focused row mounted while the modal is open; otherwise focus can be lost when DOM nodes change. spike flagged. Hana: adding spike: RED-3610 "Safety rail: focus preservation during virtualization + toast-based undo". DeployBot can you create the ticket? DeployBot: ticket created RED-3610: "Safety rail: focus preservation during virtualization + toast undo and modal rules" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3610 :white_check_mark: Priya: microcopy for toast undo: "Returned to v4.1.0 — Undo" with aria-live politely announcing "Return completed. Undo available for 30 seconds." After undo window, announce "Undo window expired." Leo: visual design: when traffic <4% show dot+% text; 4-25% show micro-bar; >25% show full mini-bar. keeps visual weight aligned to impact. also for A/B variants show small delta with color and a tooltip for exact numbers. Marcus: agree. we should also disable inline restore for versions with active feature flags that differ from baseline unless the flags are compatible; otherwise modal needs to show potential flag drift warning. backend will return a compatibility field. UI should show a flag icon with warning color and text "Feature flags differ". Priya: add to modal body: if compatibility=false, include paragraph: "This version has different feature flag settings which may change behavior. Review flags before restoring." and a small link to compare flags. ensure link is keyboard focusable. Hana: action items: 1) update figma copy to "Return" and include Shift+R shortcut note, 2) add zoom state visuals and bin behavior, 3) implement toast undo flows in spec (30s), 4) add compatibility warning UI for feature-flag mismatch, 5) work with eng on focus-preserve spike. Marcus: i'll scope the spike and return perf caveats. i'll also add server-side undo token plan to the ticket. A11yBot: recommended ARIA snippets: ```

Return to v4.1.0?

This will route new traffic to v4.1.0. Ongoing requests will finish on their current version.

Ready
``` Hana: perfect. i'll push updates to figma and the interaction spec and tag folks. thanks for the quick feedback — will loop back after the spike results. :sparkles:
